subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Redwood + Acme.ai
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Redwood + Acme.ai

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the candid overview of Acme.ai's priorities for Q4. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we stay aligned: 

Summary from our call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for conversational agents by 30% while keeping P95 latency under 200ms for user-facing flows.
- Current stack: mixed cloud GPUs + some on-prem instances; focus on predictable capacity for peak times.
- Main constraints: procurement timeline (decision target: end of Sep), strict data residency for PII.

What Redwood can help with (short list):
- Dedicated pools for predictable throughput + private deployment for on-prem requirements.
- Cost/perf analysis based on your token volumes (we offered to run a short eval).
- Security runbook and SOC2 evidence for procurement.

Proposed next steps:
1) I can put together a one-page cost/latency sketch if you share a sample daily traffic profile (simple CSV).
2) Aditya (cc'd) can scope a 2-week technical eval with a lightweight integration to test latency and cache behavior.
3) If the eval looks good, we prepare pricing for Dedicated capacity.

Attachments: redwood_playbook.pdf (onboarding + eval plan), redwood_pricing_v2.pdf (baseline pricing).

Would you be able to share a sample daily token profile this week? If procurement timing is still looking like late Sep, we can align the eval to finish in early Aug.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: redwood_playbook.pdf] [Attachment: redwood_pricing_v2.pdf]

Subject: Quick follow-up — lightweight eval windows

Alex — Aditya here from Redwood (technical lead). Marissa looped me in to offer a quick follow-up. We have a few 2-week eval windows in August where we can provision a Dedicated test pool and validate P95 latency and cost with a small sample of your traffic.

What I'd need from you (minimal):
- A one-day token profile or ~1k sample requests
- A list of any PII-sensitive flows (so we can configure private deployment options)

If timelines are tight, we can compress to a 1-week smoke test. Would you be open to a quick 15-min tech sync next week to scope?

Cheers,

Alex —

Wanted to close the loop on this thread. I haven't heard back on the sample data or a quick tech sync, and I don't want to keep pinging if priorities changed.

If Acme.ai is still interested, totally happy to reopen and coordinate an eval that fits your timeline. If your priorities shifted, can you let me know and I'll close the file on our side?

Options:
- "Yes, still interested" — send a preferred week for a 15-min sync and we'll schedule.
- "Not right now" — tell me when to check back (or we'll follow up in 90 days).
- No reply — we'll close the file and leave the door open.

Thanks for your time, Alex — wish you and the team a great week.

Best,
